name: Webform MyEmma
description: Webform handler that sends submitted email addresses (with mapped fields) to a MyEmma email-marketing group via the markroland/emma API client; supports multiple MyEmma accounts.
project_description:
Integration with MyEmma in webforms for Drupal 8/9/10. 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Requires Webform and installation using composer, depends on this php emma library .

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 composer require drupal/webform_myemma .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Once module is enabled, there are two steps:

 
 Set your account ID and API keys on the admin/config/services/webform_myemma . 
 Add the MyEmma handler to your webform, email address and group ID are required. 
 Group ID is numeric, found in the address URL when viewing a group in your MyEmma account 
 Select the account created in the module configuration that this handler should use should use. 
 Map the Source field (from the webform) to your MyEmma account using the MyEmma "field shortcut" in the Destination. You can fiend the field shortcut when editing the field in your MyEmma account. 
 Back to top
